// Each loft row gives image height, center x, width radius, center z, and depth radius.
function profile(rows) {
  const slope = (i, k) => (rows[i + 1][k] - rows[i][k]) / (rows[i + 1][0] - rows[i][0]);
  const slopes = rows.map((row, i) => row.slice(1).map((v, k) => {
    if (i === 0) return slope(0, k + 1);
    if (i === rows.length - 1) return slope(i - 1, k + 1);
    const a = slope(i - 1, k + 1);
    const b = slope(i, k + 1);
    return a * b > 0 ? 2 * a * b / (a + b) : 0;
  }));
  return y => {
    const last = rows.length - 1;
    const yy = clamp(y, rows[0][0], rows[last][0]);
    let i = 0;
    while (i < last - 1 && yy > rows[i + 1][0]) i++;
    const a = rows[i], b = rows[i + 1];
    const h = b[0] - a[0], t = (yy - a[0]) / h, s = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);

      h * t * (1 - t) * ((1 - t) * slopes[i][k] - t * slopes[i + 1][k]));
  };
}

function loft(rows, options = {}) {

  const floorScale = options.inset || (() => 1);
  const sample = (y, a) => ringPoint(at, y, a, floorScale(y), options.sculpt);

        normals.push(n.x, n.y, n.z);

          indices.push(k, k + count + 1, k + 1, k + 1, k + count + 1, k + count + 2);

      }
    }

  for (const y of [first, last]) {
    const [cx, , cz] = at(y);

function eyelid(parent, name, coords, width, material, height, yOffset = 0) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(coords.map(([x,y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y+yOffset,0)));
  const positions = [], indices = [];
  const rows = 42, sides = 12;
  for (let i = 0; i <= rows; i++) {
    const t = i / rows;
    const p = curve.getPoint(t);
    const tangent = curve.getTangent(t);
    const radius = width * (.021 + .979 * Math.pow(Math.sin(Math.PI * t), .67));
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
      const a = tau * j / sides;
      const x = p.x - tangent.y * radius * Math.cos(a);
      const y = p.y + tangent.x * radius * Math.cos(a);
      const q = point(x, y, faceZ(x,y) + height + .34 * Math.sin(a) * radius);
      positions.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      if (i < rows) {
        const k = i * sides + j, b = i * sides + (j + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(k,b,k+sides,b,b+sides,k+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const mesh = addMesh(parent, name, meshGeometry(positions, indices), material);
  mesh.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
}

function finger(hand, name, controls, radius, taper) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(controls.map(p => point(...p)));
  const group = joint(hand, name, ...controls[0]);
  const positions = [], indices = [];
  const steps = 28, sides = 16;
  const axis = new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1);
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const t = i / steps;
    const p = curve.getPoint(t);
    const tangent = curve.getTangent(t);
    const a = axis.clone().cross(tangent).normalize();
    const b = tangent.clone().cross(a).normalize();
    const cap = clamp((t - .80) / .20, 0, 1);
    const r = radius * mix(1, taper, t) * Math.sqrt(Math.max(.0001, 1 - cap * cap));
    for (let j = 0; j < sides; j++) {
      const angle = tau * j / sides;
      const q = p.clone().addScaledVector(a, r * Math.cos(angle))
                         .addScaledVector(b, .87 * r * Math.sin(angle));
      positions.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);
      if (i < steps) {
        const k = i * sides + j, n = i * sides + (j + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(k,n,k+sides,n,n+sides,k+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  addMesh(group, `${name}-skin`, meshGeometry(positions, indices), glove);
}
